comment: HD graphics (docs/HD-GRAPHICS.md): the source of the art in data/native/hd, the openciv2-assets runtime art pack, pinned. tools/build_hd_pack.py downloads this release, checks its SHA-256 and size (and each file's against its package.json) and makes data/native/hd from its data/atlas-hd.pack: the pictures the game draws, whose keys begin with one of keep and with none of drop (those src/platform/hd.c and src/game/hd_graphics.cpp draw: crops of the sheets and of the libraries' pictures, their tints, the terrain's blends, fog, the whole sheets, the resource pictures hd.c paints whole (its WHOLE), the throne room's pieces and empty hall, the advances' icons, the spaceship's pieces; dropped: the throne room's decorations, the crops hd.c does not draw (its NOT_CROPPED_KEYS), the leaders' portraits no tribe is given (hd_portraits), the city view's houses but the industrial era's rows), at most as large as drawn; and those whose keys begin with one of synth, which src/platform/synth.c reads to make the original's pictures where the game folder lacks them (docs/NO-INSTALL.md: the sheets and their crops, the libraries' GIF resources and their crops, civ2.exe's bitmaps, cursors and icons), at the original's size where the game does not draw them. A picture of another kind drawn or read there is to be added here. Upgrading the art: tag, url, sha256 and size here, then the tool.
